draft.subject: Institutional form/procedure identification: participant DNA application under N.C.G.S. 15A-146(b1) and (b2)
draft.body:
Please identify the current AOC-approved participant application, including its form number, revision date, and official source, for a person entitled to expunction under N.C.G.S. 15A-146 whose case was dismissed by the trial court and whose DNA record/profile and sample are held in the State DNA Database and Databank, to apply to that trial court for a DNA expunction order under subsections (b1) and (b2).

If there is no dedicated current AOC form, please identify the controlling AOC instruction, court rule, administrative order, or other authoritative written procedure that accepts a specifically composed application for this relief, including how subsection (c)'s approved-form requirement is satisfied. Please provide the text or official link and identify whether the procedure is statewide or limited to a particular court. A reference to ordinary dismissal expunction, juvenile DNA expunction, appellate reversal, or the district attorney's laboratory processing system would not identify this participant filing vehicle.

For that vehicle, please identify the filing office, case-number/caption requirements, required application statements or verification, hearing-setting procedure, required service method and proof, and any required companion documents. The adopted statutory route calls for the applicant to apply to the trial court and serve a copy of the application on the district attorney for the judicial district where the felony charges were brought at least 20 days before the hearing. Please identify the prescribed documents used to implement those steps.

The contemplated order materials include a certified copy of the trial-court dismissal order attached to the DNA expunction order if relief is granted; the defendant's and attorney's names and addresses; and directions to the State Crime Laboratory to purge the covered DNA record and sample and provide the required documentation letter, while preserving the statutory other-qualifying-offense exception. Please identify the prescribed order companion and whether the certified dismissal copy must also accompany the initial application, and specify who transmits the entered order and required attachments to the Laboratory.

This is a request to identify an existing institutional form or accepted filing procedure, not an individual eligibility determination. If another court office is responsible, please identify that office and its public contact channel.

responseAcceptance.required: Exact current approved application and order companion, or an authoritative written acceptance procedure for the specifically composed DNA application, with jurisdictional scope and required filing/service/disposition components.
insufficient: Ordinary CR-287 dismissal petition without explicit DNA application authority
Informal willingness to receive papers without prescribed-vehicle authority
